title: Digital Marketing Agency in Miami
metaTitle: Digital Marketing Agency in Miami, FL | TDM
metaDescription: A digital marketing agency for Miami businesses: SEO, paid ads, social media, web and video, in English and Spanish-aware campaigns. Team member based in Miami.
lead: TDM (The Digital Marketing Services) is a digital marketing agency that works with Miami businesses on SEO, paid advertising, social media, websites and video. Miami is not one market but several: locals and visitors, English and Spanish speakers, buyers in South Florida and buyers across Latin America. We plan campaigns around that mix instead of treating the city like anywhere else in the United States.

sections.heading: What makes marketing in Miami different
paragraphs: Most of Miami-Dade's residents are Hispanic, and a large share of everyday searching, scrolling and buying happens in Spanish or in both languages. A business that markets only in English is invisible to part of its own neighbourhood. That does not mean translating every page. It means deciding, service by service, where Spanish search terms, Spanish ads and bilingual customer replies will pay back.

Miami is also a gateway city. Trade, finance, real estate and travel connect it to Latin America and the Caribbean, so many local companies sell to people who are not in Florida at all. Their marketing has to work for a buyer in Bogotá or São Paulo as well as one in Brickell.

And the city runs on seasons. Winter brings visitors and part-time residents, and events such as Art Basel and the boat show move demand for weeks at a time. Budgets and content calendars that ignore the calendar waste money in the quiet months and miss the busy ones.

sections.heading: How we approach a Miami campaign
paragraphs: We start with who actually buys from you: residents, visitors, businesses or buyers abroad, and in which language. That decides the channels. Search captures people already looking, which suits services, clinics, law firms and anything booked in a hurry. Social and video build demand for restaurants, hospitality, fashion, fitness and real estate, where people choose with their eyes.
bullets: Keyword research in English and Spanish, by neighbourhood where it matters: Brickell, Wynwood, Coral Gables, Doral, Miami Beach.
A Google Business Profile kept accurate and active, because map results decide most local choices.
Ad budgets shifted with the season rather than spread evenly across the year.
Creative made for the place: real locations, real people, vertical video.
Reporting in money terms: what was spent and what it returned.

sections.heading: Local search in Miami
paragraphs: For a business that serves customers in person, the map pack is the front page. Ranking there depends on a complete business profile, consistent name and address details across the web, a steady flow of real reviews, and pages on your own site that speak about the areas you serve. People search by neighbourhood far more than by city, so one page that says "Miami" rarely covers Kendall, Hialeah and Aventura at once.

AI answers are now part of this. When someone asks an assistant for a recommendation, it draws on the same signals: clear pages, reviews, structured data and mentions on other sites. The work that helps you rank also helps you get cited.

cards.heading: Industries we see most in Miami

items.title: Hospitality and restaurants
items.text: Visitors decide fast and on a phone. Map visibility, reviews, short video and seasonal campaigns do most of the work.

items.title: Real estate
items.text: Buyers are often out of state or abroad. Listings need search visibility, video walkthroughs and ads that reach people before they arrive.

items.title: Health, beauty and wellness
items.text: Clinics and med spas compete on trust. Clear service pages, reviews and careful ad wording matter, since platforms restrict health claims.

items.title: E-commerce and fashion
items.text: Brands selling nationally from Miami need stores that convert, product photography and ads managed against margin.

items.title: Professional services
items.text: Law, finance and consulting firms win on search for specific problems, in the language the client is searching in.

items.title: Trade and logistics
items.text: Companies serving Latin America need sites and content that work for buyers in other countries and languages.

presence: A member of our team is based in Miami, so you can talk to someone who knows the city. The wider team works remotely with you: strategy, design, development and video are delivered by the same people who serve our clients in other markets.

faqs.q: Do you have someone in Miami?
faqs.a: Yes. A member of our team is based in Miami. Day-to-day work is delivered by our wider team remotely, with calls and reporting on a schedule that suits you.

faqs.q: Should a Miami business advertise in Spanish?
faqs.a: Often, yes, but not automatically. It depends on who your customers are. We look at your current customers and the search terms people use, then decide where Spanish or bilingual campaigns will return more than they cost.

faqs.q: Which marketing channel works best in Miami?
faqs.a: It depends on how people choose a business like yours. Search and maps suit services people need now. Social media and video suit restaurants, hospitality, fashion and real estate. Most businesses do best with one main channel done well and a second added later.

faqs.q: How much does digital marketing cost in Miami?
faqs.a: It depends on the channels, the amount of content and the competition in your field. We quote after a free consultation, once we understand your goals and what is already in place.

faqs.q: Can you help a Miami business sell outside Florida?
faqs.a: Yes. Many Miami companies sell nationally or to Latin America. We build the site, search visibility and ads for the markets you actually sell to, in the languages those buyers use.
